name: Storybook
summary: Sends anonymous usage data. Crash reports are a separate setting that is off by default. A content-free boot event is sent before the config file is read, so only the environment variable fully prevents telemetry.

optOut.instructions: Set core.disableTelemetry: true in .storybook/main.ts, pass --disable-telemetry, or set STORYBOOK_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=true (the only option that also stops the early boot event).
